preview.title: Analysis preview
preview.cvUnavailable: Continuous tracking and event detection are not available. Unknown stays unknown.

identity.title: Confirm this is you
identity.hint: Select sampled frames that show your jersey. Stats stay unknown until identity is confirmed.
identity.confirmed: Identity confirmed for the selected frames.
identity.rejected: Identity was not confirmed. Countable stats stay unknown.

ask.title: Ask this match
ask.hint: Questions are answered only from stored observations and events. Nothing is invented.
ask.question: Your question
ask.placeholder: e.g. Did you see a shot?

report.title: Match analysis
report.missing: This analysis could not be loaded.
report.statsUnknown: Countable stats stay unknown until validated events exist.
report.cvUnavailable: This view needs computer-vision tracking, which is not deployed.
report.noVideo: No video is available to seek.

modal.title: Analyze match video
modal.intro: ScoutX samples still frames across your film, asks you to confirm identity, and reports only what those frames support. Tracking and match stats stay unknown without a computer-vision worker.

technique.title: Technique stars
technique.basis: Estimated from sampled still frames on a 1–5 star scale. This is an AI read of a few moments, not a verified rating.
technique.unavailable: This report has no technique assessment. Run a new analysis to get star ratings for weak foot, skill moves and more.
technique.identityRequired: Technique stars need you to confirm which frames show you before the analysis runs. Confirm your identity, then analyse again.
technique.noneRated: The sampled frames did not show enough of you on the ball to give a star rating. Footage closer to the action helps.
